home.heading: Universities and Study Programs
home.intro: A free, open-source project building a structured, searchable database of public higher-education data. Focused on universities - institutions, faculties, study programs, and tracks - across Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Croatia, and Montenegro.
home.summary: Use Atlas Univerziteta to browse university profiles, compare academic offerings, and access structured public data through a simple interface or directly through the API.
home.exploreDescription: Browse universities across multiple countries. View faculties, study programs, and tracks. Search by name, city, acronym, country, entity, ownership, study cycle, and more.
home.improveDescription: Know something that's missing or incorrect? Registered users can suggest changes - additions, edits, or deletions - which are reviewed and applied by admins.
home.improveStep1: Create a free account and confirm your email
home.improveStep2: Go to the Improve Data page and submit your suggestion
home.improveStep3: Admins review submissions and apply approved changes to the live dataset
home.forDevsDescription: Atlas Univerziteta exposes a free, unauthenticated REST API. Fetch all universities, search by name, city, or acronym, retrieve full detail for a single university, or search study programs across all institutions.
home.forDevsNote: No authentication required for public endpoints.
home.openSource: This is an open-source project. View the source code, setup instructions, and contribute on

api.dataObjectExample:
{
  "id":          number   - unique identifier
  "name":        string   - university name
  "acronym":     string | null
  "city":        string
  "entity":      "FBIH" | "RS" | "BD"
  "ownership":   "PUBLIC" | "PRIVATE"
  "foundedYear": string | null
  "website":     string | null
  "address":     string | null
  "phone":       string | null
  "email":       string | null
  "_count":      { "faculties": number }  - list endpoint only
  "faculties":   Faculty[]               - detail endpoint only
}

endpointsData.getAllUniversities: Retrieve all universities, ordered by ownership then name. Includes a faculty count per university.
endpointsData.getUniversityById: Retrieve a university by ID with full nested detail (faculties, study programs, and tracks). dataSourceUrl on each unit is the URL its initial data was obtained from.
endpointsData.search: Search across universities, faculties, and study programs (track names match through their study program). Optional search term (min 2 characters) and filters; with neither, returns a full listing of everything. Matches name, city, acronym, ECTS/duration, and related unit names (case-insensitive, diacritic-insensitive).
endpointsData.searchTermParam: Text to search for (2-100 characters). Optional if at least one filter is provided.
endpointsData.getAllFaculties: Retrieve all faculties, ordered by university name then faculty name. Includes the parent university.
endpointsData.getFacultyById: Retrieve a faculty by ID with nested study programs and tracks, plus the parent university.
endpointsData.getAllStudyPrograms: Retrieve all study programs, ordered by cycle then name. Includes the parent faculty and university.
endpointsData.getStudyProgramById: Retrieve a study program by ID with its tracks, parent faculty, and university.
endpointsData.getAllTracks: Retrieve all tracks, ordered by study program name then track name. Includes the full parent chain.
endpointsData.getTrackById: Retrieve a track by ID with its parent study program, faculty, and university.
endpointsData.entityParam: Filter by entity: FBIH, RS, or BD.
endpointsData.ownershipParam: Filter by ownership: PUBLIC or PRIVATE.
endpointsData.cycleParam: Filter by study cycle. Accepts multiple values (e.g. cycle=FIRST&cycle=SECOND). Values: FIRST, SECOND, THIRD, INTEGRATED, VOCATIONAL, SPECIALIST.
endpointsData.typeParam: Result type filter: university, faculty, or studyProgram. Repeatable. Each section returns every match.
